newsitem.title: USA: West Texas Oklaunion power unit back in service.
newsitem.headline: West Texas Oklaunion power unit back in service.

text.p: West Texas Utilities Co's 666 megawatt Oklaunion coal-fired power plant returned to service over the weekend following an outage for a three-week maintenance program, a company spokeswoman said.
The plant returned to full service on Saturday from the outage, which began Sept 28, spokeswoman Linda Caton said Monday.
The plant is located 80 to 100 miles north of Abilene, Texas on the southeast edge of the Oklahoma Panhandle.
West Texas Utilities is a unit of Central and South West Corp.
